notes.title: The Contact 0.5.2.5 Release
notes.notes:
The controls are fixed and there is no more strafe along walls or going opposite directions while moving. Important: Save system completely redone so you don't need to restart your game for future updates. Please start a new game to activate the complete updates, as your old savegame may be bugged or not work at all. For those already playing, we added 10'000$ ingame money to give you an easier start and honor your tries and help to get bugs fixed.

CHANGELOG:
+ Optimized inventory
+ Full waterbottle is now stackable
+ Empty Waterbottle is now stackable
+ Raw meat is now stackable
+ Cooked meat is now stackable
+ Wood is now stackable
+ Controls fixed
+ XP points for missions ajusted
+ Money for succesfull missions ajusted
+ Complete new save system
+ Your savegames will now work even after future updates
+ Removed rats on sewer level
+ Removed 3 guards on sewer level
+ New UI for ingame messages
+ New punch sound
+ Sounds optimized for less memory usuage
+ Redone Tutorial pictures
+ Tutorial screenshots are now available on storepage too
+ Several minor bugs fixed

notes.title: The Contact 0.5.2.2 Release
notes.notes:
New Version added community feedback.
NEW CONTROLS: WASD for movement and RIGHT CLICK to interact.
Some of you may have problems with controls. Controls are now fully redone. WASD for up down left right. Notice action button now is on Right click. Added brand new tutorial info at beginning. Food making etc. speed up 50%. Also the sewer level was redone and should be now more easy to do. If you have problems loading save game, please restart from beginning because mature changes have happened to controls and it may not be available to load it correctly.

CHANGELOG:
+ Speed Up Food / Burger Maker etc.
+ New Controls (WASD, Right Click for interacting)
+ Added Food and Drink to Prison Level
+ Overall Sewer Level to make it more easy
+ Added Tutorial to first Time Players (Burglar King)
+ Fixed Minor bugs

notes.title: Early Access Release
notes.notes:
The Contact has now been released for early access.
Feedback and reviews are welcome. Next updates will replace old place holding sounds (ex. Player Hit/Punch) and more bug fixes. Game difficulty feedback is welcome. Be aware that you always have different choices of story progressing. If the sewer room level may be too hard, pick the other option when asked for story progressing and you can continue on another path.
